_doc: Reviewed journal statements that may fail during rebuild-fresh on a source-derived baseline. Key = tag + statement index ('i' or 'i/k' for the k-th top-level statement inside block i) + SQLSTATE. Every entry needs a reason. Adding an entry is a reviewed change; rebuild-fresh fails closed on anything not listed.
